bio.statement: His official biography says he is serving his second term as State Representative for House District 2.
bio.excerpt: Now serving his second term as State Representative for Oregon House District 2

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Virgle Osborne biography

bio.statement: His official biography says he has owned Twin Peaks Offroad since 2014.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Virgle Osborne biography

positions.statement: Osborne says he supports more cooperation among local, county, state and federal law enforcement to disrupt drug operations.
positions.excerpt: I strongly support increasing cooperation among local, county, state, and federal law enforcement agencies.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 1, p. 39)

positions.statement: Osborne says the Habitat Conservation Plan threatens timber jobs and that he opposes it.
positions.excerpt: Policies such as the Habitat Conservation Plan pose significant threats to timber companies and put countless jobs at risk. I am firmly opposed to these harmful policies and stand with our timber industry

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 1, p. 39)

positions.statement: Osborne says he opposes further taxes and regulations on small businesses.
positions.excerpt: I strongly oppose the implementation of further taxes and regulations on small businesses.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 1, p. 39)

positions.statement: Osborne says he has always opposed gun control measures.
positions.excerpt: I have always stood firmly against gun control measures and remain committed to protecting this fundamental right.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet, General Election Nov. 3, 2026 (Book 1, p. 39)

positions.statement: Reported by KGW, Osborne said the problem is mental health rather than gun access.
positions.excerpt: “Because we do not have a gun violence problem, we have a mental health problem,” said Rep. Virgle Osborne, R-Roseburg.

positions.statement: Reported by KGW, Osborne opposed Senate Bill 703 and questioned the state's ability to fund the program.
positions.excerpt: Rep. Virgle Osborne, R-Roseburg, questioned the state’s ability to fund the program.
